description: The walrus-cli core: top-level dispatch with mutual-exclusion enforcement, and the eight content subcommands query/extract/cat/add/update/remove/condense/convert, plus the shared -R recursion and `-`+--name stdin ingestion. Builds on FEAT-001's wal-cli-common (reuses its extract/cat engines, mask, safety, selector grammar, and names helpers). Depends on FEAT-001. The `walrus alias` helper is deliberately NOT here (FEAT-003) to keep this feature a coherent content-command unit.
steps: src/main.rs: fn main() -> ExitCode mapping a downcast CliError to its carried code, a WalrusError to its RC per the context.json WalrusError_RC_map (NotTracked->8, AmbiguousRemove->2, BinaryInput->non-zero, else RC 1), and printing diagnostics to stderr with a `walrus:` prefix. Print the usage banner for -h/--help and on a bad top-level invocation.

src/dispatch.rs: scan argv for the operation. Accept subcommand canonical (query/extract/cat/add/update/remove/condense/convert) AND the flag aliases (-q/--query, -x/--extract, -a/--add, -u/--update, -r/--remove); detect TWO operations in one invocation and return CliError::usage (RC 2, AC2); treat a bare `walrus <archive>` with no op as query (CLI-DESIGN 5.1); handle `--` terminator and -h/--help. Dispatch to the matching cmd_* module.
src/common.rs: shared option-scan helpers moved/adapted from walx (split_option, take_value) and re-exports from wal_cli_common; the add/update common grammar for -R/--recurse and `-`/--name.

src/cmd_query.rs: open the archive; filter files by optional mask (wal_cli_common::names::matching); terse listing = one `name<TAB>index_size` per line to stdout; -l/--long adds attributes (size/mtime/mode from TrackedFile.attributes) + log bytes (names::log_bytes) + generation cap. index size = TrackedFile.versions.count.

src/cmd_extract.rs: parse extract args (archive, optional mask, selector via wal_cli_common::selector, -o/--force/--sanitize) and call wal_cli_common::extract::run; return its RC (incl. beyond-last RC 4 and refuse RC 2 already implemented in the shared engine).
src/cmd_cat.rs: parse cat args (archive, file, selector) and call wal_cli_common::cat::run (one-match-or-RC2, beyond-last RC4).

src/recurse.rs: a deterministic directory walk: collect regular files under a directory root in SORTED relative-path order; skip symlinks and non-regular files (device/socket/FIFO) with a stderr note (not a failure); derive each stored name as `<root-name>/<relative>` with the OS separator normalised to `/` (CLI-DESIGN 5.4b/5.4c normalize-on-write). Return (stored_name, bytes) pairs.

src/stdin_src.rs: buffer stdin to EOF; enforce `-` requires --name (RC2 if missing), --name requires a `-` source (RC2 if given with file args), `-` appears at most once and not mixed with files, and -R not combined with `-` (RC2) (AC9b/c). Validate --name through wal_cli_common::safety (illegal/escaping name -> RC2, AC9f).

src/cmd_add.rs: parse args (archive, files.../`-`, --generations, --wal/--wbl/--direction, -R). Resolve create-time direction via seed order (explicit flag -> archive extension for a brand-new archive -> default Forward; existing archive uses manifest variant). Open-or-create the Archive (Archive::new(Manifest::new(variant)) when the file does not exist). For each source (file arg, recursed file, or stdin buffer): call Archive::add(name, bytes, generations, dir); a directory arg without -R is RC 2 (AC7a); a binary input aborts the whole batch (transactional) non-zero (AC7d/AC9d); a no-change save prints a stderr note and stays RC 0 (CLI-DESIGN 5.4). Persist once via Archive::write at the end (transactional).

src/cmd_update.rs: like cmd_add but each file must already be tracked -- Archive::update returns NotTracked -> map to RC 8 (AC3/AC7e/AC9e); supports -R and `-`+--name; --generations; no-op note; transactional write. Uses the diff feature path (Archive::update).

src/cmd_remove.rs: parse (archive, mask, --force). Expand the glob via wal_cli_common::names::matching: zero matches -> RC 8; more than one without --force -> RC 2 listing the matches (AmbiguousRemove sense); then call Archive::remove(name, force) per matched exact name and write.

src/cmd_condense.rs: parse (archive, mask, --keep <n> default 0). Expand glob via names::matching; empty -> RC 8 (pre-check, since the library returns Rebase for no-match); call Archive::condense(name, keep) per matched name and write.

src/cmd_convert.rs: parse (archive, optional mask, --to <wal|wbl> required, -o <name> optional). to = Variant/Direction from --to. No mask = whole-archive convert; with a mask, pre-check names::matching empty -> RC 8. Call let new = archive.convert(mask_opt, Some(to))?; write `new` to the -o name if given, else back to the archive path (transactional). Print an extension-rename SUGGESTION on stderr; never auto-rename on disk (AC4).

tests/common/mod.rs: a fixture builder mirroring walx's -- build multi-file archives (forward and reverse, nested names, fixed timestamps) through the public Archive API under TempDir; a run_walrus(cwd, args) spawning CARGO_BIN_EXE_walrus; code_of helper.

Write one tests/*.rs per feature area with the test names listed in frw11-plan.md section 6 item 1 (mutual_exclusion.rs, query.rs, extract_cat.rs, add.rs, update.rs, recurse.rs, stdin.rs, remove.rs, condense.rs, convert.rs). Follow strict TDD: each test RED first, then minimum code to GREEN.
Keep every src/*.rs under 400 non-test lines; if a cmd_*.rs grows, split its arg-parse half into cmd_<name>_args.rs.
acceptance_criteria: AC1 query: bare `walrus <archive>` and `walrus query` list tracked files + index size; -l adds attributes + log bytes. Verified by query.rs tests over a fixture.
AC2 two operations in one invocation -> RC 2 (mutual_exclusion.rs).
AC3 update/remove/condense/convert on a non-existent target -> RC 8.
AC4 convert flips per-file direction (mask) or whole-archive (no mask), round-trips byte-identically, suggests but does not perform an on-disk rename, writes under -o when given.
AC5 add --wal/--wbl/--direction seed order honoured on create and IGNORED for an already-tracked file.
AC6 behaviour verified over fixtures, not just unit tests (each subcommand has a tests/ integration test).

AC7 -R recursion: directory-without-R is RC2; with -R the relative tree is stored and a walx extract round-trips it; walk is sorted, skips symlinks/special files; a binary file aborts the batch leaving the archive unchanged; update -R of an untracked file is RC 8.

AC8 add/update stamp each recorded change with a fixed-shape UTC timestamp YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ so --at resolves on CLI-produced archives (asserted via a round-trip that writes then selects with --at).

AC9 stdin: `-`+--name creates/updates from piped bytes (walx cat reproduces); `-` without --name and --name without `-` are RC 2; `-` mixed with files or -R is RC 2; binary stdin is rejected non-zero and leaves the archive unchanged; update `-` on an untracked name is RC 8; --name stored verbatim and an illegal --name is RC 2.
Return codes 0/2/4/8 and the typed-error map match CLI-DESIGN section 6.
verification: cargo tree -p walrus-cli  (confirm NO pulldown-cmark/scraper/csv/printpdf/docx-rs/egui/eframe/encoding_rs; similar via diff is allowed)
findings:
DONE (scoped checks clean; owner's full `cargo gate --build` still pending per hand-off). Binary `walrus` at crates/walrus-cli; depends ONLY on walrus-fmt features=["diff"] + wal-cli-common + anyhow (dev-dep tempfile). cargo tree -p walrus-cli shows NONE of pulldown-cmark/scraper/csv/printpdf/docx-rs/egui/eframe/encoding_rs; similar+unicode-segmentation present via the diff feature (expected). All src/*.rs <= 400 non-test lines (largest cmd_add.rs 249).

AC8 RESOLUTION (approved additive seam in crates/walrus, this stream's own crate; walrus-fmt EXISTING behaviour unchanged, INV-2 intact, no new runtime dep -- the library stays CLOCK-FREE and receives the string): added `WalrusError::InvalidTimestamp { value: String }` (error.rs) and a new module crates/walrus/src/mutate_stamp.rs exposing: `Archive::add_at(name, bytes, generations: Option<u32>, dir: Option<Direction>, ts: &str) -> Result<()>` (always available) and `#[cfg(feature="diff")] Archive::update_at(name, bytes, generations: Option<u32>, ts: &str) -> Result<()>`. Both validate `ts` against the fixed UTC shape YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ via the existing crate `timestamp::parse_ts_epoch` (InvalidTimestamp on failure) then thread it onto the recorded splice through mutate_add's `store_save`, which now takes `ts: Option<&str>` and stamps the appended forward record (and the inverted reverse record[s]). The plain `add`/`update`/`update_with_splices` pass `None` -> record stays unstamped exactly as before. mutate_add helpers widened to pub(crate) for the sibling module: store_save, store_save_from_text, current_bytes, id_for_selector, set_generations_by_id, update_inner, and free fn utf8_or_binary. mutate_add.rs kept at exactly 400 non-test lines by moving the stamping impl+tests into mutate_stamp.rs. walrus-cli reads the clock in src/clock.rs (std SystemTime + dependency-free civil_from_days, no chrono) formatting now() as the fixed shape; cmd_add/cmd_update call add_at/update_at. A create records nothing so no stamp; the first real save carries ts.

FOR THE INTEGRATION STEP / REVIEWER:
- Dispatch (src/dispatch.rs): `Op` enum; canonical subcommand only in argv[0]; flag aliases -q/-x/-a/-u/-r anywhere; TWO ops -> CliError::usage RC 2 (AC2); bare archive -> Op::Query; top-level -h/--help/help -> banner RC 0; `--` terminates op scanning. Returns (Op, rest-tokens) so each cmd module re-parses its own grammar.
- RC mapping lives once in src/main.rs::rc_for_walrus_error: NotTracked->8, AmbiguousRemove->2, everything else (BinaryInput, SpliceNotCharBoundary, InvalidTimestamp, ...)->1. CliError carries its own code (2 for usage/safety; remove/condense/convert build CliError{code:8} for the no-match pre-check).
- remove/condense/convert expand the glob via wal_cli_common::names::matching to EXACT names and drive the library op per matched name (library matches exact id-or-name only). condense/convert pre-check matching-empty -> RC 8 (condense's library no-match is Rebase, not NotTracked). remove multi-match-without-force -> RC 2 (CLI-side listing, never reaches the library's AmbiguousRemove because the CLI drives single exact names).
- convert: no mask = whole-archive archive.convert(None, Some(dir)); with mask = fold convert(Some(name), Some(dir)) over matched names; writes back to the archive path or to -o; prints an extension-rename SUGGESTION to stderr, never auto-renames (AC4).
- -R recursion (src/recurse.rs): sorted relative-path walk, regular files only, symlink/special skipped with stderr note, stored name = <root-name>/<relative> with OS sep normalised to '/'. stdin (src/stdin_src.rs): '-'+--name rules all RC 2 (dash requires name; name requires dash; dash not mixed with files; -R not with dash; --name validated through wal_cli_common::safety -> escaping/illegal RC 2). add/update are transactional: Archive::write runs once at the end, so a mid-batch binary/NotTracked error leaves the on-disk archive byte-for-byte unchanged.
- No-change save: add/update detect an unchanged count across the save and print a `<name>: no change, not versioned` stderr note, RC 0.
- Integration tests verify mutation round-trips by reopening the archive via walrus_fmt::Archive (equivalent to a walx extract round-trip; CARGO_BIN_EXE_walx is not available to walrus-cli's test crate). tests/common/mod.rs builds fixtures through the public Archive API under TempDir and spawns CARGO_BIN_EXE_walrus (run_walrus / run_walrus_stdin / code_of + reconstruct/record_count/first_ts helpers).
- FEAT-003 (`walrus alias`) is deliberately NOT in this feature; dispatch has no `alias` op yet -- add it there.
